payload.name: Preserve-concrete-advice-in-extraction
payload.description: When a source message contains explicit advice or recommendations alongside general encouragement, during memory extraction and updates, to ensure the concrete guidance is preserved.
content: During candidate extraction from a message containing explicit advice or recommendations, make the concrete guidance the core of the candidate content; do not summarize the message as only general support or encouragement.
Capture the specific action and its purpose or condition when the source states it, so the extracted memory preserves the full recommendation.
Before finalizing an extraction candidate, verify that any direct advice in the source message appears in the candidate; generic positivity is insufficient when an actionable instruction is present.
During CRUD, when updating an existing memory with new message evidence, keep previously or newly stated concrete advice intact rather than replacing it with vague support.

solves: The diagnosed cause is that extraction collapsed a message containing an explicit recommendation into generic support, losing the actionable fact needed to answer later questions. The reusable mechanism is treating advice and encouragement as equally extractable rather than prioritizing sentiment. Apply during construction whenever a speaker gives direct advice, instructions, or recommendations; do not apply to messages that only express emotional support.
